messages: emily: Heads-up — I'm opening a batch move for /guides -> /reference/guides. It's 10 files split across 3 PRs. Want to coordinate reviewers and merge order so we don't break anchors. sam: Thanks. Can you list which files are in each PR? Prefer small PRs first so previews are fast. emily: PR A (3 files) mostly minor frontmatter changes. PR B (4 files) has a couple of anchor renames. PR C (3 files) includes big examples and a redirect map. lee: Assign me to PR A and PR B. I'll take a quick pass today. mario: I can review PR C but need preview links before I sign off — the examples are sensitive to build config. emily: Noted. I'll @preview-bot once PRs are up. Also planning to add redirects for old paths in PR C, but want to delay merging redirects until all content is in place. olivia: Small question: are we keeping old anchors or migrating them? I expect external links will break if we drop anchors now. emily: Plan is: keep temporary anchors (old-name) for 2 weeks via HTML anchors, then remove after we confirm traffic is low. Redirects for full pages will be added in PR C but gated. docs-bot: Reminder: label PRs with `docs/move` and `needs-preview` so automation picks them up. ci-bot: PR B — docs-preview check failed on Netlify: broken anchor detected in /reference/guides/auth.md -> anchor `#token-flow` not found. sam: Which PR introduced the anchor rename? emily: that was PR B — the anchor was renamed to `#authentication-flow`. mario: Can we add a compatibility anchor in the new file? Like "" near the new section. emily: I'll push a tiny fix to PR B to add the compat anchor. Won't affect content. preview-bot: Preview links: - PR A: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-428 - PR B: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-429 (failing anchor check) - PR C: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-430 lee: I looked at PR A preview — clean. Approving now. :thumbsup: lee: PR B fix looks good in preview after compat anchor. CI green. sam: Suggest merge order: PR A, then PR B (with compat anchor), then PR C (add redirects). That minimizes public breakage. emily: Sounds good. For PR C we will include redirects file: `docs/_redirects.json` with mappings. I'll mark it `merge-blocker: redirects` until we have a coordinated window. olivia: Can we schedule the redirect merge for Friday 10:00 PT? Lower traffic window. mario: Works for me, but we should coordinate with infra in case we need to rollback. @eng-sre FYI. emily: Will open a short runbook: how to revert redirects and how to re-add anchors if needed. sam: Also add a note in the changelog: people who link to anchors should update within 2 weeks. emily: Pushed PR B compat commit and updated labels. Merging PR A now. docs-bot: PR A merged by emily at 1829991150. preview-bot: Rebuilding previews... PR B preview: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-429 (now passes anchor checks) lee: Merged PR B. Will hold PR C until Friday window. mario: I'll do final review on Friday morning and then give go/no-go. emily: Thanks all. If anyone sees outgoing traffic spikes to the old anchors, flag here and we'll hold on redirects. sam: One tiny improvement idea for future moves: add a small automated compatibility script that injects legacy anchors during the first merge. Reduces manual fixes. emily: Filing a follow-up issue for that. For now, we're green and scheduled. :party_parrot:
